chunks: When Shu'aib said to them: 'Will you not take heed?'

key_terms.تَتَّقُونَ: You take heed / You practice God-consciousness (from taqwa)
key_terms.شُعَيْبٌ: Prophet Shu'aib, peace be upon him

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Shu'aib say to his people in Surah al-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the universal prophetic mission of Shu'aib (AS), emphasizing that *taqwa* is the foundational criterion for moral rectification beyond mere economic justice. The brevity of the command underscores the centrality of divine consciousness as the root of all ethical conduct, a theme frequently cited by Imams to illustrate the priority of inner piety over outward ritual. This narrative serves as a paradigm for the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and the Imams in their call to the people of Mecca and Medina.
